journey: Guest browses the sample catalog and signs in
steps: Open the landing page signed out; the catalog link shows only owner-approved sample products
Open a sample product; no price, no private photo and no other organisation's data is shown
Try a staff or workspace URL signed out; you are sent to sign in, never shown the page
Sign in as a buyer; the full catalog with your contract prices replaces the samples

journey: Buyer fills the keranjang and checks out an order
steps: Sign in as a branch buyer and open the catalog
Pick a product, choose a kemasan and a quantity, and add it to the keranjang
Open the keranjang, choose the branch and the delivery details
Review the quote (per-channel groups, totals in Rupiah) and submit
See the order number (PSN-…) and find the order in Pesanan saya with its filters
Order again from the same keranjang; a new order is placed and the first one is not repeated

journey: Order to dispatch to receipt across personas
steps: Buyer submits an order from the keranjang
Branch approver reviews it; store head accepts it on the store order desk
Stock is reserved and released from the store's stock source
Warehouse prepares and dispatches the order with a numbered Surat Jalan
Courier assignment is recorded and the shipment leaves
Buyer confirms receipt; the order timeline shows every step with its number
Each page shows loading, denied, offline and 'Belum pasti / Periksa hasil' states instead of failing silently

journey: Invoice release to verified buyer payment
steps: Store finance proposes an invoice release for a received order; a second person decides it
The invoice is issued with its number
Buyer opens the invoice and uploads a payment proof (camera or file) with a preview
OCR suggests amount and reference; the buyer confirms and submits
Payment checker reviews the proof and verifies or rejects it
The payment is allocated to the invoice; the buyer sees the paid status

journey: Procurement request to received and valued goods
steps: Store raises a procurement request; it is approved and funded
A purchase order (SP-…) is issued to the supplier
The supplier is paid in advance or the disbursement is recorded
Goods are received, inspected and accepted for quality
Accepted goods become stock and are valued
The supplier payable and its bank settlement are recorded
Store staff propose a replacement kemasan for an order line
Buyer declines one proposal and consents exactly to another
A lost reply is recovered with the original key, never repeated
The real replacement is dispatched
Buyer reports a problem with a received order (case)
Store reviews the case and decides return, replacement or credit
Returned goods are received as a return lot and checked
A refund or credit is recorded and its payout evidence is kept
Supplier claims are raised for supplier-caused faults

journey: Branch requests, spending policy and approvals
steps: Buyer sends a branch request (PB-…) to the store
Store accepts or rejects it with a reason; the buyer sees the result
An order above the branch budget waits for the branch approver
The approver cannot approve their own proposal (maker/checker guard shown)
An inactive branch's history stays readable but cannot be ordered against
Finance stages a bank statement import; a second person approves it
Incoming bank receipts are matched to payments or left in suspense
Duplicate-payment signals are shown and explained
A receiving-account change needs a separate approval
Every payment decision is in the audit trail
Set up the accounting book (chart and mapping) with maker/checker
Open AR/AP aging and invoice-ready reports for a period
Sign in as auditor; every list and report opens read-only
Export a report; the export is scoped and recorded

journey: Staff workspaces: one shell, one queue, consistent pages
steps: Sign in as each staff role; the home shows that role's work and sidebar
Pekerjaan saya lists waiting work across owners, ordered by deadline
Pick records by name or code, not by internal id
Every decision opens a review panel that is itself the confirmation
Dates, money (Rp…, staff screens with ,00) and statuses read the same everywhere
Pages work at 390 px and by keyboard with no horizontal scroll

journey: Accounts, sign-in, delegation and access review
steps: Admin invites a person; they sign in and set up MFA
A privileged action asks for step-up
An account is recovered by the documented recovery path
A temporary delegation is granted and expires; a suspended account loses access immediately
Join, move and leave change a person's access; the access review lists effective access

journey: Catalog, identifiers, photos and prices maintained by staff
steps: Catalog clerk edits a product, its kemasan and the base-unit content
Trade codes and GTINs per kemasan level are validated
A primary photo is uploaded, scanned and approved
A price change is proposed and approved by a second person
A pack conversion rule is approved and used for a physical stock conversion

journey: Warehouse: scanning, stock sources and counts
steps: Receive goods by scanning (camera, keyboard wedge or manual entry)
Pick and dispatch by scanning against the Surat Jalan
Activate and reconcile a stock source with maker/checker
Run a blind stock count with separate approval
Replenishment suggests quantities from lead time
Build the release from a clean checkout with one command
Start the stack; the operator health page shows every dependency
Back up Mongo, the evidence store and the key directories together
Restore into an empty environment and time it; the app starts and reads old records
A crash mid-write recovers without duplicate effects
